history.summary: An 807 sqft freehold 2BR at Whitescape, a boutique D15 (Marine Parade/East Coast) block built 2012, 700m from TE27 Marine Terrace MRT, at $1.58M / $1,958 psf. Freehold 2BR in deep-buyer-pool D15 with TEL access is the right format, but the 7.3%/yr appreciation rests on just 6 transactions (unreliable) and asking PSF is ~5% above the $1,870 median.
history.rating_rationale: The format and location are sound — freehold 2BR (widest tenant/buyer pool) in D15 with TEL Marine Terrace 700m away and East Coast lifestyle. But the headline 7.3%/yr CAGR is built on only 6 URA transactions, so it can't be trusted, and $1,958 psf is a ~5% premium to median in a small boutique block with limited liquidity. Reasonable hold, but you're paying above median on thin data — Neutral.
red_flags: Only 6 URA transactions — 7.3%/yr appreciation rate is unreliable
Boutique block — thinner resale liquidity than large developments
catalysts: Freehold 2BR in deep-pool D15 — widest buyer/tenant demand
700m to TE27 Marine Terrace (Thomson-East Coast Line)
